answer.text: Discover the issue price via investor bids within a price band

explanation.text: The Logic: Book-building aggregates demand at different prices within a band to set final price. The Trap: Fixed-price issues don't use book-building. Cross-Exam Context: Same in IX, XII. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Evaluate book-building subscription patterns (HNI vs retail vs QIB) for IPO advice.
